Title: Stream MVP - Project and Analysis Foundation
Body:
## Outcome
Create a recoverable Unreal project that can pre-analyze one licensed track with supported engine tools.

## Success Measures
- The project opens after a clean restart.
- Audio Synesthesia and Movie Render Queue are enabled.
- A ConstantQNRT asset is connected to the approved test track.

## Delivery Cards
- Create a recoverable Unreal project shell.
- Prepare a licensed test track and ConstantQNRT asset.

Title: Stream MVP - Deterministic Visualizer
Body:
## Outcome
Produce repeatable per-band mesh motion from pre-analyzed audio on one shared playback clock.

## Success Measures
- Three runs of the same segment produce matching visual events.
- Smoothing, scale, and emissive response are controllable.
- The first implementation does not depend on the old custom CQT compiling.

Title: Stream MVP - Render and OBS Launch
Body:
## Outcome
Turn the deterministic scene into synchronized media and pass a private OBS stream rehearsal.

## Success Measures
- Sync is checked at the start, middle, and end.
- OBS receives audio exactly once.
- A fallback scene and short operator runbook are ready.

Title: Polish - RTCQT Visual Language
Body:
## Outcome
Recover the strongest visual and spectrum-shaping ideas from the old module after the Stream MVP works.

## Success Measures
- Circle or spiral layouts are available.
- Any custom RTCQT processing has a documented visible benefit over ConstantQNRT.
- Performance remains within the render target.

Title: Live - Real-Time and Interactive Delivery
Body:
## Outcome
Evaluate live Unreal capture and a shared browser room without putting the proven pre-rendered stream path at risk.

## Success Measures
- Live capture has measured frame-time and OBS results.
- Pixel Streaming works on the local network before any public hosting work begins.
